Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Moore Park and the footbridge is not available

ㅤ
infoLinks.content:
At Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Moore Park and the footbridge is temporarily out of service.
 
The lifts are out of service until further notice while replacement works are carried out.
 
During this period, use the accessible entry/exit pathway via the crossing at the intersection of Anzac Parade and Lang Road, or via the Entertainment Quarter side, or use the stairs at this stop if you are able to do so safely.
 
Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

John Street Square Light Rail Lift 2 between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is not available

ㅤ
infoLinks.content:
At John Street Square Light Rail Lift 2 between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use the lift on the opposite side of the stop, closest to Harris Street
 
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500
